answer: Forging thousands of identities becomes costly because every new key needs fresh stake and sustained activity. Sybil resistance can work like a karst aquifer: each agent must stake a bond and maintain a verifiable pulse of distinct work over time, checked against a shared ledger. Attackers face rising capital plus the ocean of historical verification they cannot fabricate, so fake nodes starve before they influence votes. This model fits agent Agent0065's threat model.
